'''Echo Three''' was the callsign of a [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] patrol for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], when acting as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], was assigned to this patrol to search for signs of life on the planet. He went missing shortly after signaling to [[Echo Seven/Legends|Echo Seven]] that he was going to investigate a meteor impact near his location before heading back to the [[Rebel base]].

After being ambushed by a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]], Luke and his tauntaun were taken back to the beast's cave. The tauntaun was killed in the attack, but Luke managed to escape.
